seo.ogTitle: DomainGuard: Customer Domain Router for Jira Service Management
seo.ogDescription: Map email domains to JSM organizations automatically. Freemail Shield, tenant isolation, bulk sync and audit log. 100% Forge native.

lead: Put every Jira Service Management customer in the right organization automatically, based on their email domain. Block Gmail-style public domains, flag unknown domains, and bring existing customers in with one click.

marketplace.label: Try it Free on Atlassian Marketplace

overview.heading: The Right Customer in the Right Organization
overview.text: In Jira Service Management, organizations decide which customers can see each other's requests. Keeping them up to date by hand is slow and error-prone, and one mistake can show a customer another company's tickets. DomainGuard does it for you: when a request comes in, it reads the reporter's email domain and adds them to the organization you mapped to that domain.

highlights.title: Every customer in the right organization
highlights.text: Map e-mail domains to JSM organizations, with optional subdomains. New requesters are added on their first request, and one click syncs the customers you already have.

highlights.title: Gmail users never join a client org
highlights.text: Freemail Shield blocks 30,000+ public and disposable e-mail domains, plus your own list. Unknown domains are labelled and kept private. Dry-run any address before it arrives.

highlights.title: Every routing decision on record
highlights.text: The audit log shows which organization each request joined and why, or why it was quarantined. E-mail addresses are masked and entries expire after 30 days.

features.title: Domain Mapping Matrix
features.text: Map up to **500 email domains** to each JSM organization. Optionally match subdomains, limit a rule to specific service desks, and set a priority for requests from that customer.

features.title: Automatic Routing
features.text: Every new request is routed in the background: the reporter joins the right organization and the request's **Organizations** field is set. Auto-sharing and linking the organization to the service desk are opt-in per rule.

features.title: Freemail Shield
features.text: About **30,000 public email providers** (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo and more) can never be mapped, so unrelated people are never grouped together. Add your own domains or exceptions; flagged requests get a `quarantine-freemail` label.

features.title: Tenant Isolation for Unknown Domains
features.text: Requests from domains you haven't mapped are tagged `unmapped-domain`, or fully isolated with `quarantine-unmapped` and an empty Organizations field until an agent reviews them.

features.title: Sync Existing Customers
features.text: Added a new rule? One click scans your existing users in the background and adds everyone with a matching domain to the organization, with live progress.

features.title: Audit Log & Retry
features.text: Every routing decision is logged for 30 days with masked email addresses. Filter by request key or date and retry any request in one click after fixing a rule.

items.title: Map domains
items.text: Add a rule such as `acme.com` → the **Acme** organization, with optional subdomains and service desk limits.

items.title: A request comes in
items.text: DomainGuard reads the reporter's email domain in the background as soon as the request is created.

items.title: Route or protect
items.text: Mapped domains join their organization; public providers and unknown domains are labelled and, if you choose, kept private.

items.title: Review the audit log
items.text: Every decision is recorded with the matched rule and the actions taken. Fix a rule and retry in one click.

trust.heading: 100% Forge-Native Architecture
trust.text: DomainGuard is eligible for the **Runs on Atlassian** program. Built exclusively on the Atlassian Forge platform, your customers' data never leaves Atlassian Cloud: zero external server egress, zero external databases.

quickstart.heading: Quickstart (Under 5 Minutes)
steps: Install DomainGuard on your **Jira Service Management Cloud** site as an administrator.
Open **Jira Settings → Apps → DomainGuard: Customer Domain Router for JSM**.
Add a domain rule, for example `acme.com` → the **Acme** organization.
Click **Sync Existing Users** to bring in customers you already have.
Raise a test request from an `@acme.com` address and check the Audit Log.
